guidance.summary: Targets Q4 smartphone volumes between 7 million to 7.5 million units
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall
guidance.quote: Q4 volumes are expected to be somewhere between 7 million to 7.5 million.

guidance.summary: Targets smartphone camera module volumes of 190 to 200 million units per annum
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall
guidance.quote: We're expanding the capacities and deepening the level of manufacturing of camera and fingerprint modules for smartphone and target to expand volumes of smartphone camera modules from 40 million units in this fiscal to 190 million to 200 million units per annum.

guidance.summary: Targets mobile phone business margins between 2.8% to 3.2%
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall
guidance.quote: We still feel that we should be able to have a margin of somewhere between 2.8% to 3.1%, 3.2% in our mobile phone business.

guidance.summary: Expects mobile export revenue of INR 5,500 to 6,000 crores in FY26
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall
guidance.quote: We feel we should be closing at almost INR5,500 crores, INR6,000 crores in the current fiscal.

guidance.summary: Expects total FY26 capex between INR 1,100 crores to 1,200 crores
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall
guidance.quote: And we feel that in the overall fiscal, it should be somewhere between INR1,100 crores, INR1,200 crores.

guidance.summary: Expects IT hardware revenue around INR 1,500 crores in FY26
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall
guidance.quote: So this year, we feel the revenue should be in the range of INR1,500-odd crores.

guidance.summary: Expects IT hardware revenue between INR 3,500 to 4,000 crores in FY27
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall
guidance.quote: We feel that for next year, the numbers are going to be somewhere around INR3,500 crores to INR4,000 crores.

guidance.summary: Expects telecom segment FY26 revenue close to INR 5,200 crores
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall
guidance.quote: This year, we should have revenues close to INR5,200 crores.

guidance.summary: Expects Longcheer JV volume of 8 to 10 million units in FY27
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall
guidance.quote: We feel that in '27 -- '26-'27, it will be around 8 million to 10 million units.

guidance.summary: Plans display business capex of closer to INR 1,100 to 1,200 crores
guidance.speaker: Saurabh Gupta
guidance.quote: We will be putting capex of closer to INR1,100 crores, INR1,200-odd crores.

guidance.summary: Plans Q Tech camera modules capex of INR 250 to 300 crores
guidance.speaker: Saurabh Gupta
guidance.quote: In Q Tech, the camera modules capex intensity should be closer to INR250 crores, INR300-odd crores.
